title: Abstraction Kills
coreMove: Reattach a name, face, and consequence to any category before letting the category decide.
sourcePressure: Names abstraction as the danger of distance: people become units, functions, or reports, letting harmful choices feel professional because the human cost is unseen.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Claiming all models, rules, or numbers are bad, rather than showing when distance replaces responsibility.

counterintuition: numbers versus people as a flat binary

exampleSpecs.stakes: patients vanish behind bed-days and throughput

skillTargets: spot when a category has replaced a person

tryThisNowSpec: Take one anonymous label in a decision and replace it with one concrete person and the consequence they will feel.
